name: hand-drawn
title_zh: 把18种手绘风格装进一个提示词包
tagline_zh: 想要吉卜力、水墨、蜡笔画却不会描述？报个名字，它把风格细节、参考参数打包成可直接用的提示词。
tagline_en: Want Ghibli, ink-wash, or crayon art but can't describe it? Name a style; it packs the details into ready-to-use.
desc_en: Use when users ask for a hand-drawn or illustrated image prompt, name one of the repository's 18 numbered styles or the 3.1 stable variant, or mention triggers such as 亲子手绘、家庭蜡笔画、蜡笔、吉卜力、水墨、像素、淡彩速写、动画概念、水粉、北欧绘本、纸雕、软胶潮玩、墨线绘本、暖色扁平绘本、family-crayon-card、warm-flat-storybook. Produces prompt text or a formal reference-bearing call bundle and does not generate images.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的'风格词库'，而是带编号的18种风格+稳定变体，触发词精准，输出带参考标记的调用包。
why_en: Not a vague style list—18 numbered styles plus a stable variant, with precise triggers and reference-bearing call bundles to cut.
limit_zh: 只产出提示词文本或调用包，不生成图像；必须匹配仓库内18种风格或其触发词，超出范围不保证效果；需要配合支持参考标记的图。
limit_en: Outputs prompts/call bundles only, no images; works only for the 18 built-in styles or their triggers; requires an image tool that supports.
